description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for condition models used in a widget framework, including nested classes for various condition types (and, or, not, compare, regexp, permission checks, etc.) and a factory for creating condition instances based on XML elements.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition
classes.description: Abstract base class for condition models, representing an immutable XML-based condition structure supporting various logical and permission-based conditions.

classes.name: ModelCondition
classes.description: Interface for condition objects used in widget models.

classes.name: ModelConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating ModelCondition instances from XML elements.

classes.name: DefaultConditionFactory
classes.description: Default implementation of ModelConditionFactory, creating condition instances based on XML node names.

classes.name: And
classes.description: Represents an 'and' condition combining multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: Or
classes.description: Represents an 'or' condition combining multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: Xor
classes.description: Represents an exclusive 'xor' condition among sub-conditions.

classes.name: Not
classes.description: Represents a negation of a sub-condition.

classes.name: IfCompare
classes.description: Represents a comparison condition between a field value and a specified value.

classes.name: IfCompareField
classes.description: Represents a comparison between two fields.

classes.name: IfEmpty
classes.description: Checks if a specified field is empty.

classes.name: IfHasPermission
classes.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission or entity permission.

classes.name: IfRegexp
classes.description: Performs a regex match on a field value.

classes.name: IfValidateMethod
classes.description: Invokes a static validation method via reflection.

methods.name: readSubConditions
methods.description: Reads sub-condition XML elements and creates a list of ModelCondition instances.
